Title: Public preview: Azure Virtual Network Manager in nine new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual Network Manager is now in public preview in nine new regions. You can create an Azure Virtual Network Manager instance in nine additional regions and manage your virtual networks at scale across regions, subscriptions, management groups, and tenants globally from a single pane of glass.

  • US South Central
  • Southeast Asia
  • Canada Central
  • Japan East
  • Japan West
  • Australia East
  • UK South
  • Switzerland North
  • Central India

With this announcement, Azure Virtual Network Manager public preview is now available in 20 Azure regions worldwide. Azure Virtual Network Manager helps you create your desired topologies like hub and spoke and mesh with just a few clicks. The security admin rules feature allows you to enforce security policies throughout your organization.

Learn more:

Azure Virtual Network Manager Product Page
